name: chernobyl
description: CHERNOBYL — one interface. Every agent. Monorepo: shared protocol, Node host service, Expo mobile app.

scripts.build: npm run build:protocol && npm run build:host
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:protocol && npm run typecheck -w @chernobyl/host && npm run typecheck -w @chernobyl/mobile
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:mobile
